short.en: Write in Markdown in every GLPI rich-text editor: knowledge base, tickets, followups, tasks, solutions. Tables, code blocks with a Copy button, callouts. Works fully air-gapped.

long.en:
Adds a **Markdown** switch above every rich-text editor in GLPI, on by default: knowledge base articles and translations, ticket / problem / change descriptions, followups, tasks, solutions, validations and reminders.
- **GitHub-flavored Markdown**: headings, lists, task lists, tables, fenced code blocks with a language, quotes, links, images. - **Your Markdown is kept**: reopening an item shows the exact text you wrote. If someone edits it in the rich-text editor, it is converted back to Markdown. - **Callouts**: Obsidian `> [!warning] Title` (all Obsidian types, foldable with `[!type]-`) and GitHub `> [!NOTE]` alerts. - **One-click Copy button** on code blocks, also on plain-HTTP intranet servers. - **Fully air-gapped**: no CDN, no external requests, no build step. Libraries (marked, turndown) are bundled. - The rendered HTML is stored in GLPI's own fields, so content still displays normally if the plugin is disabled.
Works on GLPI 10.0, 11.0 and 12.0 from one package. On GLPI 12 the new knowledge base editor is supported too.
